services.name: Private Backcountry Shoreline Adventure
services.desc: --- Embark on an unforgettable journey from Kona, soaring by helicopter over the Big Island's dramatic landscapes to the remote and rugged Kohala Coast. Mid-flight, your helicopter will touch down at our remote and exclusive site where you will embark on a guided 1.5 mile hike to discover two secret waterfalls, immersing yourself in the untouched beauty and complete solitude of this rarely visited paradise. This unique adventure, accessible only by helicopter, offers active individuals an unparalleled and intimate connection with Hawaii's pristine backcountry. --- Flight Details AIRCRAFT: $6,975.00 • Private Backcountry Flight, Landing, and Waterfall Adventure Hike • Up To 5 Guests
